error.message:
Usage: gpt-image-2-skill images generate [OPTIONS] --prompt <PROMPT> --out <OUT>

Options:
      --prompt <PROMPT>
          
      --out <OUT>
          
  -m, --model <MODEL>
          
      --instructions <INSTRUCTIONS>
          [default: "You are a concise assistant."]
      --background <BACKGROUND>
          [default: auto] [possible values: auto, transparent, opaque]
      --size <SIZE>
          
      --quality <QUALITY>
          [possible values: auto, low, medium, high]
      --format <OUTPUT_FORMAT>
          [possible values: png, jpeg, webp]
      --compression <OUTPUT_COMPRESSION>
          
      --n <N>
          
      --moderation <MODERATION>
          [possible values: auto, low]
  -h, --help
          Print help
